commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Windows and PowerShell support, faster API responses, and a skill that fetches its own sources on any forge.

CLI
- serve works on Windows. Files no longer return 400 "invalid path" for every request.
- Reviews load when saved as UTF-8 with a BOM or as UTF-16LE, the encoding PowerShell 5.1 writes.
- API responses are about 35% faster on Windows and macOS. Independent git reads run in parallel.

Skill
- The skill reads the request body and review comments through the forge CLI picked from the remote URL, so it works on any forge. It no longer needs a sources directory from the user.
- Shell detection, and a PowerShell reference for the Workflow steps and Refresh.
- Refresh uses Node instead of curl and jq, and prints the review folder it copies to.
- Pins npx comprehende@0.12.0.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
